notes.title: DTG Remake Development Status Report 25.06.2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/dffdebf611aa8229b684dbfb1292068a62359745.png[/img]

[h1][b]The remake. What do you expect?[/b][/h1]

What will await you is an exciting story told by the surrounding area.
The story is about a young man suffering from depression.
The game leaves you open to the possibility of how the story will end.

[h1]The quirks of the original game are remedied with the remake as much as possible.[/h1]

[u]That would be:[/u]
[list]
[*] [h1]The bad english [/h1]

[*] [h1]The players who were affected by some images and videos now have the possibility to choose if they want to see this content [/h1]
[b][Cencored Version Abitlity][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/b2a1492b17bbcfc89cd108fd52f597fd8bef200e.png[/img]

[*] [h1]The quite uninhibited world has now been made more interactive and more interesting in the context is the game is not so boring and you have things to do[/h1] [b][Added Gamplay Elements][/b]


[*][h1]Since several voices have spoken against the "One way doors" I decided to remove them[/h1]

[*][h1]The generic quality of the game[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/f69c29a70c05533e3c5f35fa8671aae9f89cf5c1.png[/img]
[/list]

Generally a lot of content has been added
which in general enrich the story and the environment


[h1]
Technical improvements compared to the original game[/h1]
[list]
[*] [h1]Save and Load System [/h1]

[*] [h1]Diary System [/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/fa2e7ae67d8da1f0b00476301cf4a76ec589784e.png[/img]

[*] [h1]Fantastic graphics[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/5d4c579b0b386dcaf67a7e75e1d4449e5a464e84.png[/img] 

[*] [h1]The environment is much more alive[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/01ee5146092a47860cb1b2b10d26f8045cc64c61.png[/img]

[*] [h1]Better physics, interactions, movement, sound and much more[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/374edd81f6477d1811dfa7c32d54cfd3c464f2dd.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32994311/8f7126a8503eb1ac22403782cfe54a2e8b8f75bc.png[/img]

[/list]


[h1]System Requirements Minimum:[/h1]
[list]
[*] QuadCore CPU
[*] Nvidia GTX 1050 or similar with min 2 GB Ram
[*] 8 GB Ram

[*] DirectX 11 or DirectX 12 on Windows
[*] OpenGL Core 4.1+/ES3.0+ on Windows
[*] .net 4.x support

[b][u]Supported Aspect Ratio[/u][/b]
[*] 4:3
[*] 3:2
[*] 16:9
[*] 16:10
[/list]
